agreement_attack_source_note: All five §8 numbers use the MAXOUT-generated adversarial examples (tex:679-680). The headline 53.6% (rbf predicts softmax's class) is 'softmax_vs_rbf_on_maxout_adv' (attacker=maxout, ref=softmax, pred=rbf). 'softmax_vs_rbf_on_softmax_adv_secondary' is the prior implementation's reading (attacker=softmax) retained as a divergence diagnostic; SPEC §6 item 29 records the choice.
description: Shallow RBF on MNIST; FGSM eps=0.25; cross-model class agreement (section 8). RBF confidence uses the UNNORMALIZED per-class exp(q) reading (SPEC §6 item 9).
note: Sub-scale run (rbf_epochs=10, maxout_epochs=10, soft_epochs=10, patience=10). The paper notes quadratic models are hard to train with SGD (tex:616-617); the RBF net may underfit. RBF confidence uses the unnormalized per-class exp(q) reading (SPEC §6 item 9) so it CAN structurally reach the paper's 1.2%/60.6%/0% (a softmax reading is bounded below by 1/K and cannot).
